# Wisdom Walk

> Wisdom Walk is a 100% free Bible study mobile app for iOS and Android with 9 offline Bible translations, audio chapters, daily AI devotionals, and pastoral guidance.

## Core Features
- **9 Offline Bible Translations**: Complete offline access to Scripture without needing internet or cellular data.
- **Audio Chapters**: Spoken chapters with auto-advance and adjustable playback speed for commuters and audio listeners.
- **Cinematic AI Bible Videos**: Engaging visual interpretations of Bible narratives.
- **Daily Verse and Devotionals**: Personalized daily reflections powered by AI tailored to your walk with God.
- **Pastoral Guidance Chat**: Scripture-grounded interactive answers for faith, prayer, and biblical study.
- **Multilingual Support**: Available in 9 languages including English, Tamil, and Spanish.

## Pricing Model
- 100% Free
- No subscriptions
- No in-app purchases (IAP)
- No ads
